objects.description: [LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202) has the ability to directly call native Windows API items during execution.(Citation: Sentinel Labs LockBit 3.0 JUL 2022)(Citation: INCIBE-CERT LockBit MAR 2024)
